title: Generalize Puzzle2dBoard Surface To Board2d
description: Generalize the SurfaceKind::Puzzle2dBoard surface (wire "puzzle2d-board") into the generic Board2d surface (wire "board-2d") across ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, framework/core/js/index.ts, framework/renderer/react/ui-interpreter.tsx (+ host component), framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, and call sites in the owning puzzle plugin crate. Parent should be 26/07/17/GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES but that id is not recognized by ticket_open; opening top-level, will note in close summary.
summary: Verified the Puzzle2dBoard->Board2d generalization is complete and self-consistent; no source changes needed.
